**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Clear the continuation guard when closing on mobile**

When a resumed review is opened and then closed while the viewport is at or below the tablet breakpoint, this branch never clears `reviewContinuationHandled`. The continuation effect has already removed `writeReview` but retained the same `restaurant` parameter, so it also leaves the ref intact; if the viewport is later widened, the resize handler skips the desktop redirect because the ref remains truthy while the desktop render guard returns `null`, leaving a blank `/stamp` page. Clear the guard on every close, while keeping only the redirect itself conditional on desktop width.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Exclude live staged receipts from owner cleanup completion**

When OCR successfully replaces a receipt, this staging row remains `retired = false`, `complete = false` while the review references the new object. The authenticated `finish_review_media_cleanup()` still returns the count of every incomplete owner row (`20261008200719_review_verification_private.sql:72`), so `retryReviewMediaCleanup()` can never return success afterward: MY page permanently shows cleanup pending, and subsequent successful edits/deletes report `REVIEW_CLEANUP_PENDING`. Fresh evidence beyond the earlier admin-completion comment is that this later staging migration creates a live incomplete row, while only the admin completion predicate was narrowed; either exclude referenced/unretired staging rows from owner completion or add a committed staging state.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Refresh the follow-up source manifest**

Running `python backend/bin/verify_readiness_followup_20261011.py` on this commit always raises `FOLLOWUP_SOURCE_DRIFT`: `source-manifest-v1.json` records pre-follow-up hashes for multiple files that this same commit subsequently changes, including the nightly publication scripts, OCR route, cleanup helper, and local migration/readback code. Regenerate the source manifest and its detached artifact-map pin from the final source tree, or explicitly validate these entries against their historical commit instead of the working tree. [docs/agents/verification.mdL35-L35](https://github.com/twoimo/tzudong/blob/dde05b31725e2bdff43e05dc9517ce640f9d68f8/docs/agents/verification.md#L35-L35)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep verifier checks active under optimized Python**

When this verifier is run with `python -O` or `PYTHONOPTIMIZE` set, Python removes this and every other `assert` in the file, so detached map pins, artifact inventories and hashes, historical source bindings, summary counts, and deployment-claim checks can all be skipped while the script still prints passed results. Replace these assertions with explicit conditional failures so optimized execution cannot falsely admit the frozen evidence. [docs/agents/verification.mdL35-L35](https://github.com/twoimo/tzudong/blob/dde05b31725e2bdff43e05dc9517ce640f9d68f8/docs/agents/verification.md#L35-L35)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Rebuild the validator command for the current checkout**

On any checkout that does not reproduce the author's macOS home directory, this executes the frozen command verbatim from `canonical-zero-v3/basis.json`, whose executable and script paths begin with `/Users/twoimo/...`. Running `python backend/bin/verify_transitions_adoption_20261012.py` in a clean Linux checkout therefore reaches this line and raises `FileNotFoundError` instead of validating the retained performance artifacts. Preserve the recorded command as evidence, but invoke the validator with the available Node executable and repo-relative script/artifact paths. [docs/agents/verification.mdL35-L35](https://github.com/twoimo/tzudong/blob/17637cc9822c1e6695d467d051a357fcf7a39b50/docs/agents/verification.md#L35-L35)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep scroll-verifier checks active under optimized Python**

Separately from the existing transitions-adoption finding, running this newly added verifier with `python -O` or `PYTHONOPTIMIZE` removes this and every subsequent `assert`, allowing altered artifact maps, source bindings, browser results, or test totals to reach the unconditional `passed` output. Replace these assertions with explicit conditional failures so the frozen scroll evidence cannot be admitted without validation. [docs/agents/verification.mdL35-L35](https://github.com/twoimo/tzudong/blob/f71a473401b76a781e1f654120b4b34094ede74b/docs/agents/verification.md#L35-L35)
